description: Tier 1 trigger evals — does the right skill fire for a given prompt? These skills are typically installed alongside the open zime-gtm-skills set, so the collision risk runs both ways: prep-note must fire on pre-call prep intents, and must NOT fire on post-call review intents that belong to the open repo's audit skills (should_trigger: null means no skill in THIS repo should fire). Run via skill-creator's scripts/run_eval.py.

cases.prompt: I have a call with Northwind in an hour — get me up to speed.
Build me a prep note for tomorrow's demo with the Acme team.
Here's the calendar invite for Friday's QBR — what do I need to know walking in?
I'm joining this deal mid-stream as the SE — brief me before the technical call next week.
What should I know before my renewal conversation with this account on Thursday?
Review this discovery call and tell me what the rep missed on pain and decision process.
Check this call against MEDDICC and tell me what's missing before the forecast call.
Did this call end with an actual dated next step, or just 'we'll circle back'?
What are the top pain points this prospect raised, ranked by confidence?
